verdict.rationale: Oneleet's Public API is URI-versioned under /api/v1/, and its OpenAPI spec marks fields "deprecated": true with migration guidance. The spec also separates the stable public API from internal routes that "can change without notice." However, no standalone versioning or deprecation-policy page exists (the changelog returns 404), and no notice window is stated, so the documented-policy half of the story is unmet. Missing for 10: a published deprecation/versioning policy, a stated deprecation notice window, a changelog, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: all routes are URI-versioned under /api/v1/, and the spec carries "deprecated": true members with migration guidance
Those routes aren't part of the public API: they aren't listed here, they can change without notice
